verdict.rationale: Merge-conflict resolution is a fair question for a GitHub client app that reviews and merges pull requests, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers reviewing, approving and merging PRs, with no conflict-resolution tool of any kind, let alone a multi-file one. A community user also describes the app as not really a git client.

support.subject: As a developer, I can resolve merge conflicts across many files at once with a dedicated tool
